sanskrit: pātayann uttamāṅgāni gandharvāṇāṃ mahārathaḥ kṣaṇena vyadhamat sarvāṃ citrasenasya vāhinīm
english: That great chariot-warrior, striking down the heads of the Gandharvas, in a single moment shattered the entire army of Citrasena.

sanskrit: te vadhyamānā gandharvāḥ sūtaputreṇa dhīmatā bhūya evābhyavartanta śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
english: Yet those Gandharvas, though being slaughtered by the wise son of a charioteer, came on again in hundreds and thousands.

sanskrit: gandharvabhūtā pṛthivī kṣaṇena samapadyata āpatadbhir mahāvegaiś citrasenasya sainikaiḥ
english: In an instant the earth seemed transformed into Gandharva-land, covered by the troops of Citrasena rushing forward with tremendous speed.

sanskrit: atha duryodhano rājā śakuniś cāpi saubalaḥ duḥśāsano vikarṇaś ca ye cānye dhṛtarāṣṭrajāḥ nyahanaṃs tat tadā sainyaṃ rathair garuḍanisvanaiḥ
english: Then King Duryodhana, Śakuni the son of Subala, Duḥśāsana, Vikarṇa, and the other sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra struck down that enemy force with their chariots thundering like Garuḍa.

sanskrit: bhūyaś ca yodhayām āsuḥ kṛtvā karṇam athāgrataḥ mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa hayacāreṇa cāpy uta vaikartanaṃ parīpsanto gandharvān samavārayan
english: They fought again, placing Karṇa at the fore, and with a great roar of chariots and the swift movement of horses, seeking to protect the son of Vikartana, they checked the Gandharvas.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃnyapatan sarve gandharvāḥ kauravaiḥ saha tadā sutumulaṃ yuddham abhaval lomaharṣaṇam
english: Then all the Gandharvas clashed together with the Kauravas, and a tremendous, hair-raising battle commenced.

sanskrit: tatas te mṛdavo 'bhūvan gandharvāḥ śarapīḍitāḥ uccukruśuś ca kauravyā gandharvān prekṣya pīḍitān
english: Then the Gandharvas, tormented by arrows, began to give way, and the Kauravas shouted aloud seeing the Gandharvas pressed hard.

sanskrit: gandharvāṃs trāsitān dṛṣṭvā citraseno 'tyamarṣaṇaḥ utpapātāsanāt kruddho vadhe teṣāṃ samāhitaḥ
english: Seeing his Gandharvas thrown into panic, Citrasena, exceedingly wrathful, leapt from his seat in fury, intent on their destruction.

sanskrit: tato māyāstram āsthāya yuyudhe citramārgavit tayāmuhyanta kauravyāś citrasenasya māyayā
english: Then Citrasena, a master of wondrous stratagems, deployed his weapon of illusion and fought; by his magical power the Kauravas were bewildered.

sanskrit: ekaiko hi tadā yodho dhārtarāṣṭrasya bhārata paryavartata gandharvair daśabhir daśabhiḥ saha
english: For at that time, O Bhārata, each single warrior of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's army found himself surrounded by ten Gandharvas fighting against him.

sanskrit: tataḥ saṃpīḍyamānās te balena mahatā tadā prādravanta raṇe bhītā yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Crushed by that great force, they fled in fear from the battlefield to where King Yudhiṣṭhira stood.

sanskrit: bhajyamāneṣv anīkeṣu dhārtarāṣṭreṣu sarvaśaḥ karṇo vaikartano rājaṃs tasthau girir ivācalaḥ
english: While the armies of the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra broke and fled on all sides, O king, Karṇa the son of Vikartana stood firm as an immovable mountain.

sanskrit: duryodhanaś ca karṇaś ca śakuniś cāpi saubalaḥ gandharvān yodhayāṃ cakruḥ samare bhṛśavikṣatāḥ
english: Duryodhana, Karṇa, and Śakuni the son of Subala continued to fight the Gandharvas in battle, though grievously wounded.

sanskrit: sarva eva tu gandharvāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ jighāṃsamānāḥ sahitāḥ karṇam abhyadravan raṇe
english: Then all the Gandharvas in hundreds and thousands, united in their desire to kill him, rushed upon Karṇa in battle.

sanskrit: asibhiḥ paṭṭiśaiḥ śūlair gadābhiś ca mahābalāḥ sūtaputraṃ jighāṃsantaḥ samantāt paryavārayan
english: Those mighty warriors, seeking to slay the charioteer's son, surrounded him on all sides with swords, broad-bladed spears, lances, and maces.

sanskrit: anye 'sya yugam acchindan dhvajam anye nyapātayan īṣām anye hayān anye sūtam anye nyapātayan
english: Some severed his yoke, others struck down his banner; some cut his shaft, some felled his horses, and others brought down his charioteer.

sanskrit: anye chatraṃ varūthaṃ ca bandhuraṃ ca tathāpare gandharvā bahusāhasrāḥ khaṇḍaśo 'bhyahanan ratham
english: Others shattered his parasol, his chariot-casing, and the curved railing, and those many thousands of Gandharvas smashed his chariot to pieces.

sanskrit: tato rathād avaplutya sūtaputro 'sicarmabhṛt vikarṇaratham āsthāya mokṣāyāśvān acodayat
english: Then the charioteer's son leapt down from his ruined chariot, sword and shield in hand, mounted the chariot of Vikarṇa, and urged its horses away to safety.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca gandharvais tu mahārāja bhagne karṇe mahārathe saṃprādravac camūḥ sarvā dhārtarāṣṭrasya paśyataḥ
english: Vaiśampāyana said: O great king, when the great chariot-warrior Karṇa was routed by the Gandharvas, the entire army of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son fled while he watched.

sanskrit: tān dṛṣṭvā dravataḥ sarvān dhārtarāṣṭrān parāṅmukhān duryodhano mahārāja nāsīt tatra parāṅmukhaḥ
english: Seeing all of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's men turn their backs and run, Duryodhana, O great king, did not himself turn away.

sanskrit: tām āpatantīṃ saṃprekṣya gandharvāṇāṃ mahācamūm mahatā śaravarṣeṇa so 'bhyavarṣad ariṃdamaḥ
english: Seeing the great Gandharva host rushing toward him, that subduer of foes poured down upon them a heavy shower of arrows.

sanskrit: acintya śaravarṣaṃ tu gandharvās tasya taṃ ratham duryodhanaṃ jighāṃsantaḥ samantāt paryavārayan
english: Disregarding the shower of arrows, the Gandharvas, intent on killing Duryodhana, surrounded his chariot on all sides.

sanskrit: yugam īṣāṃ varūthaṃ ca tathaiva dhvajasārathī aśvāṃs triveṇuṃ talpaṃ ca tilaśo 'bhyahanan ratham
english: They shattered the yoke, the shaft, the body of the car, the banner and the charioteer alike; they felled the horses, the three-piece pole, and the floor-frame, beating the chariot to fragments.

sanskrit: duryodhanaṃ citraseno virathaṃ patitaṃ bhuvi abhidrutya mahābāhur jīvagrāham athāgrahīt
english: Citrasena, that mighty-armed one, rushed upon Duryodhana as he fell to the ground unhorsed and seized him alive as a prisoner.

sanskrit: tasmin gṛhīte rājendra sthitaṃ duḥśāsanaṃ rathe paryagṛhṇanta gandharvāḥ parivārya samantataḥ
english: When he was thus taken, O lord of kings, the Gandharvas surrounded Duḥśāsana, who still stood in his chariot, encircling him on all sides.

sanskrit: viviṃśatiṃ citrasenam ādāyānye pradudruvuḥ vindānuvindāv apare rājadārāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: Some Gandharvas sped off carrying Viviṃśati away, while others took Citrasena; still others seized Vinda and Anuvinda, and yet others carried off the royal ladies one and all.

sanskrit: sainyās tu dhārtarāṣṭrasya gandharvaiḥ samabhidrutāḥ pūrvaṃ prabhagnaiḥ sahitāḥ pāṇḍavān abhyayus tadā
english: The troops of Dhṛtarāṣṭra's son, attacked by the Gandharvas, joined with those who had already fled and came then to the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: śakaṭāpaṇaveśyāś ca yānayugyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ śaraṇaṃ pāṇḍavāñ jagmur hriyamāṇe mahīpatau
english: The camp-followers, the market people, the courtesans, and all those with vehicles and draft animals sought refuge with the Pāṇḍavas when the king was being carried off.

sanskrit: priyadarśano mahābāhur dhārtarāṣṭro mahābalaḥ gandharvair hriyate rājā pārthās tam anudhāvata
english: "That comely and mighty-armed king, the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, mighty in strength, is being carried away by the Gandharvas — O Pārthas, pursue him!"

sanskrit: duḥśāsano durviṣaho durmukho durjayas tathā baddhvā hriyante gandharvai rājadārāś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: "Duḥśāsana, Durviṣaha, Durmukha, and Durjaya have been bound and are being carried off by the Gandharvas, along with all the royal ladies."

sanskrit: iti duryodhanāmātyāḥ krośanto rājagṛddhinaḥ ārtā dīnasvarāḥ sarve yudhiṣṭhiram upāgaman
english: So crying aloud in their eagerness for the king's welfare, all of Duryodhana's ministers came to Yudhiṣṭhira in distress, speaking in pitiful voices.

sanskrit: tāṃs tathā vyathitān dīnān bhikṣamāṇān yudhiṣṭhiram vṛddhān duryodhanāmātyān bhīmaseno 'bhyabhāṣata
english: Seeing those aged ministers of Duryodhana thus afflicted, despondent, and supplicating Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīmasena addressed them.

sanskrit: anyathā vartamānānām artho jāto 'yam anyathā asmābhir yad anuṣṭheyaṃ gandharvais tad anuṣṭhitam
english: "For those who have been acting contrary to right conduct, this outcome has come about by contrary means. What should have been done by us has instead been done by the Gandharvas."

sanskrit: durmantritam idaṃ tāta rājño durdyūtadevinaḥ dveṣṭāram anye klībasya pātayantīti naḥ śrutam
english: "This is the fruit of bad counsel, O friend — of the king who gambled wickedly. We have heard the saying that others bring down the hater who is a coward."

sanskrit: tad idaṃ kṛtaṃ naḥ pratyakṣaṃ gandharvair atimānuṣam diṣṭyā loke pumān asti kaś cid asmatpriye sthitaḥ yenāsmākaṃ hṛto bhāra āsīnānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ
english: "And now this superhuman deed has been done before our very eyes by the Gandharvas. Fortunate it is that there exists in this world someone who acts in our interest — someone who has lifted from us the burden that, while we sat at ease, brought us comfort."

sanskrit: śītavātātapasahāṃs tapasā caiva karśitān samastho viṣamasthān hi draṣṭum icchati durmatiḥ
english: "That evil-minded one desires to see us — who endure cold, wind, and scorching heat and have grown lean through austerity — reduced from our equal standing to an unequal and wretched state."

sanskrit: adharmacāriṇas tasya kauravyasya durātmanaḥ ye śīlam anuvartante te paśyanti parābhavam
english: "Those who follow the conduct of that wicked-souled Kuru prince who walks the path of unrighteousness — they behold their own ruin."

sanskrit: adharmo hi kṛtas tena yenaitad upaśikṣitam anṛśaṃsās tu kaunteyās tasyādhyakṣān bravīmi vaḥ
english: "Unrighteousness indeed was committed by the one who devised all this. But we sons of Kuntī are free of cruelty; I speak to you as overseers of that unrighteous one."

sanskrit: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ kaunteyaṃ bhīmasenam amarṣaṇam na kālaḥ paruṣasyāyam iti rājābhyabhāṣata
english: As the impatient son of Kuntī, Bhīmasena, was speaking thus, the king said to him: "This is not the time for harsh words."

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca asmān abhigatāṃs tāta bhayārtāñ śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ kauravān viṣamaprāptān kathaṃ brūyās tvam īdṛśam
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: "How can you speak such words, dear friend, toward these Kauravas who have come to us in fear, seeking refuge, fallen into adversity?"

sanskrit: bhavanti bhedā jñātīnāṃ kalahāś ca vṛkodara prasaktāni ca vairāṇi jñātidharmo na naśyati
english: "O Vṛkodara, there will always be quarrels and dissensions among kinsmen, and enmities that persist — yet the duty owed to kinsmen is never destroyed."

sanskrit: yadā tu kaś cij jñātīnāṃ bāhyaḥ prārthayate kulam na marṣayanti tat santo bāhyenābhipramarṣaṇam
english: "But when an outsider assails a kinsman's family, good men do not endure that assault by an outsider."

sanskrit: jānāti hy eṣa durbuddhir asmān iha ciroṣitān sa eṣa paribhūyāsmān akārṣīd idam apriyam
english: "This evil-minded one knows full well that we have been dwelling here in the forest for a long time. And yet, disregarding us, he has done this disagreeable thing."

sanskrit: duryodhanasya grahaṇād gandharveṇa balād raṇe strīṇāṃ bāhyābhimarśāc ca hataṃ bhavati naḥ kulam
english: "By the Gandharva's forcible seizure of Duryodhana in battle and by the defilement of the women by outsiders, our family line itself is shamed."

sanskrit: śaraṇaṃ ca prapannānāṃ trāṇārthaṃ ca kulasya naḥ uttiṣṭhadhvaṃ naravyāghrāḥ sajjībhavata māciram
english: "For the sake of those who have sought refuge and for the protection of our family, rise up, O tigers among men, and arm yourselves without delay."

sanskrit: arjunaś ca yamau caiva tvaṃ ca bhīmāparājitaḥ mokṣayadhvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ hriyamāṇaṃ suyodhanam
english: "Arjuna, the twin brothers, and you, unconquered Bhīma — free Suyodhana the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra who is being carried away."

sanskrit: ete rathā naravyāghrāḥ sarvaśastrasamanvitāḥ indrasenādibhiḥ sūtaiḥ saṃyatāḥ kanakadhvajāḥ
english: "Here are these chariots, O tigers among men, fully equipped with all weapons, yoked by charioteers headed by Indrasena, bearing golden banners."

sanskrit: etān āsthāya vai tāta gandharvān yoddhum āhave suyodhanasya mokṣāya prayatadhvam atandritāḥ
english: "Mount these, dear friend, and strive without fatigue in battle against the Gandharvas for the liberation of Suyodhana."

sanskrit: ya eva kaś cid rājanyaḥ śaraṇārtham ihāgatam paraṃ śaktyābhirakṣeta kiṃ punas tvaṃ vṛkodara
english: "Even any ordinary king would protect to the utmost of his power an enemy who came seeking refuge — how much more so you, O Vṛkodara?"

sanskrit: ka ihānyo bhavet trāṇam abhidhāveti coditaḥ prāñjaliṃ śaraṇāpannaṃ dṛṣṭvā śatrum api dhruvam
english: "Who else in this world, urged on and seeing an enemy with hands clasped in supplication who has sought refuge, would not surely rush forward to give protection?"

sanskrit: varapradānaṃ rājyaṃ ca putrajanma ca pāṇḍava śatroś ca mokṣaṇaṃ kleśāt trīṇi caikaṃ ca tat samam
english: "The granting of a boon, the gaining of a kingdom, the birth of a son, O Pāṇḍava — these three are said to be equal; and the deliverance of an enemy from distress is equal to all three combined."

sanskrit: kiṃ hy abhyadhikam etasmād yad āpannaḥ suyodhanaḥ tvadbāhubalam āśritya jīvitaṃ parimārgati
english: "What could be greater than this — that Suyodhana in his calamity now seeks his very life relying on the strength of your arms?"

sanskrit: svayam eva pradhāveyaṃ yadi na syād vṛkodara vitato 'yaṃ kratur vīra na hi me 'tra vicāraṇā
english: "I myself would rush forward, O Vṛkodara, if it were not that this sacrifice here is being performed — I have no hesitation about this, O hero."

sanskrit: sāmnaiva tu yathā bhīma mokṣayethāḥ suyodhanam tathā sarvair upāyais tvaṃ yatethāḥ kurunandana
english: "O Bhīma, strive to free Suyodhana by conciliation first; then strive by all means available, O joy of the Kuru race."

sanskrit: na sāmnā pratipadyeta yadi gandharvarāḍ asau parākrameṇa mṛdunā mokṣayethāḥ suyodhanam
english: "If the king of the Gandharvas does not yield to conciliation, then free Suyodhana by gentle but resolute force."

sanskrit: athāsau mṛduyuddhena na muñced bhīma kauravān sarvopāyair vimocyās te nigṛhya paripanthinaḥ
english: "And if he does not release the Kauravas even with gentle fighting, O Bhīma, then by every means subdue those enemies who bar the way and free them."

sanskrit: etāvad dhi mayā śakyaṃ saṃdeṣṭuṃ vai vṛkodara vaitāne karmaṇi tate vartamāne ca bhārata
english: "This much is all I am able to enjoin upon you, O Vṛkodara, while this sacrificial rite is being performed here, O Bhārata."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca ajātaśatror vacanaṃ tac chrutvā tu dhanaṃjayaḥ pratijajñe guror vākyaṃ kauravāṇāṃ vimokṣaṇam
english: Vaiśampāyana said: Hearing those words of Ajātaśatru, Dhanaṃjaya pledged himself as the guru's word demanded — to the liberation of the Kauravas.

sanskrit: arjuna uvāca yadi sāmnā na mokṣyanti gandharvā dhṛtarāṣṭrajān adya gandharvarājasya bhūmiḥ pāsyati śoṇitam
english: Arjuna said: "If the Gandharvas do not release the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra through conciliation, then today the earth shall drink the blood of the Gandharva king."

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca arjunasya tu tāṃ śrutvā pratijñāṃ satyavādinaḥ kauravāṇāṃ tadā rājan punaḥ pratyāgataṃ manaḥ
english: Vaiśampāyana said: Hearing that pledge of Arjuna, who never speaks falsely, the spirits of the Kauravas, O king, returned to them once more.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca yudhiṣṭhiravacaḥ śrutvā bhīmasenapurogamāḥ prahṛṣṭavadanāḥ sarve samuttasthur nararṣabhāḥ
english: Vaiśampāyana said: Hearing the words of Yudhiṣṭhira, all those bulls among men, with Bhīmasena at their fore, rose up with joyful faces.

sanskrit: abhedyāni tataḥ sarve samanahyanta bhārata jāmbūnadavicitrāṇi kavacāni mahārathāḥ
english: Then all those great chariot-warriors, O Bhārata, donned their impenetrable armor wrought with gold and adorned with varied ornaments.

sanskrit: te daṃśitā rathaiḥ sarve dhvajinaḥ saśarāsanāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ pratyadṛśyanta jvalitā iva pāvakāḥ
english: Those Pāṇḍavas, fully armored and mounted in their chariots with banners flying and bows in hand, shone like blazing fires.

sanskrit: tān rathān sādhu saṃpannān saṃyuktāñ javanair hayaiḥ āsthāya rathaśārdūlāḥ śīghram eva yayus tataḥ
english: Mounting those well-equipped chariots yoked with swift horses, those tigers among chariot-warriors swiftly set forth from there.

sanskrit: tataḥ kauravasainyānāṃ prādurāsīn mahāsvanaḥ prayātān sahitān dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍuputrān mahārathān
english: Then a great shout arose from the Kaurava troops when they saw the mighty chariot-warriors, the sons of Pāṇḍu, going forth together.

sanskrit: jitakāśinaś ca khacarās tvaritāś ca mahārathāḥ kṣaṇenaiva vane tasmin samājagmur abhītavat
english: The sky-moving Gandharvas, exulting in their victory, and the great chariot-warriors, came swiftly together in that forest in an instant, fearless.

sanskrit: nyavartanta tataḥ sarve gandharvā jitakāśinaḥ dṛṣṭvā rathagatān vīrān pāṇḍavāṃś caturo raṇe
english: Then all the Gandharvas, proud of their victory, turned back when they saw the four Pāṇḍava heroes mounted in their chariots facing them in battle.

sanskrit: tāṃs tu vibhrājato dṛṣṭvā lokapālān ivodyatān vyūḍhānīkā vyatiṣṭhanta gandhamādanavāsinaḥ
english: Seeing them blazing forth like the guardians of the world risen to battle, the dwellers of the Gandhamādana mountain drew up their formations and stood their ground.

sanskrit: rājñas tu vacanaṃ śrutvā dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ krameṇa mṛdunā yuddham upakrāmanta bhārata
english: Remembering the word of the wise Dharmarāja, they approached the battle gradually and gently, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: na tu gandharvarājasya sainikā mandacetasaḥ śakyante mṛdunā śreyaḥ pratipādayituṃ tadā
english: But the soldiers of the Gandharva king, being dull-witted, could not at that time be brought to their better senses by gentle means.

sanskrit: tatas tān yudhi durdharṣaḥ savyasācī paraṃtapaḥ sāntvapūrvam idaṃ vākyam uvāca khacarān raṇe
english: Then the invincible Savyasācī, that scorcher of foes, spoke these conciliatory words to those sky-dwellers in battle.

sanskrit: naitad gandharvarājasya yuktaṃ karma jugupsitam paradārābhimarśaś ca mānuṣaiś ca samāgamaḥ
english: "This is not an act worthy of the king of the Gandharvas — this reprehensible conduct: the violation of another's wives and engaging in combat with men."

sanskrit: utsṛjadhvaṃ mahāvīryān dhṛtarāṣṭrasutān imān dārāṃś caiṣāṃ vimuñcadhvaṃ dharmarājasya śāsanāt
english: "Release these mighty sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and free their ladies too, by the command of Dharmarāja."

sanskrit: evam uktās tu gandharvāḥ pāṇḍavena yaśasvinā utsmayantas tadā pārtham idaṃ vacanam abruvan
english: Thus addressed by the glorious Pāṇḍava, the Gandharvas laughed and then spoke these words to Pārtha.

sanskrit: ekasyaiva vayaṃ tāta kuryāma vacanaṃ bhuvi yasya śāsanam ājñāya carāma vigatajvarāḥ
english: "Dear friend, in this world we would do the bidding of only one person — acting upon whose command we move about free of all distress."

sanskrit: tenaikena yathādiṣṭaṃ tathā vartāma bhārata na śāstā vidyate 'smākam anyas tasmāt sureśvarāt
english: "We act as that one alone has commanded, O Bhārata. We have no master other than that lord of the gods."

sanskrit: evam uktas tu gandharvaiḥ kuntīputro dhanaṃjayaḥ gandharvān punar evedaṃ vacanaṃ pratyabhāṣata
english: Thus addressed by the Gandharvas, Dhanaṃjaya, the son of Kuntī, replied to the Gandharvas again with these words.

sanskrit: yadi sāmnā na mokṣadhvaṃ gandharvā dhṛtarāṣṭrajam mokṣayiṣyāmi vikramya svayam eva suyodhanam
english: "If you Gandharvas will not release the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra through peaceful means, then I myself shall free Suyodhana by force of arms."

sanskrit: evam uktvā tataḥ pārthaḥ savyasācī dhanaṃjayaḥ sasarja niśitān bāṇān khacarān khacarān prati
english: Having spoken thus, Pārtha Savyasācī Dhanaṃjaya then loosed sharp arrows upon those sky-dwellers against sky-dwellers.

sanskrit: tathaiva śaravarṣeṇa gandharvās te balotkaṭāḥ pāṇḍavān abhyavartanta pāṇḍavāś ca divaukasaḥ
english: And in like manner those mighty Gandharvas pressed upon the Pāṇḍavas with a shower of arrows, and the Pāṇḍavas likewise pressed upon those dwellers of heaven.
